name: @pipeworx/mcp-simbad

tools.name: object
tools.description: Resolve and fetch the basic record for an object identifier (e.g. "M31", "HD 209458").

tools.name: tap
tools.description: ADQL TAP query against the SIMBAD database (sync). Returns JSON by default.

query.description: ADQL, e.g. "SELECT TOP 5 main_id FROM basic WHERE otype = 'G'"

tools.name: cone_search
tools.description: Objects within a radius of (RA, Dec) decimal degrees.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-simbad forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the simbad pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
